name: Peroni Lager
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Italy's #1 beer from Birra Peroni, founded 1846 in Rome. The iconic blue label served in every trattoria from Milan to Sicily.

🍺 STYLE: Crisp, refreshing Italian lager | 5.1% ABV, 24 IBU | Clean Pilsner-style with delicate hops | Brewed with Italian maize for crisp finish.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Pizza margherita, pasta aglio e olio, prosciutto, mozzarella, caprese salad, seafood pasta, wood-fired pizza.

💡 SERVING TIP: Serve ice cold (38-40°F) in a chilled glass. Perfect aperitif before meals—authentic Italian beer culture!

name: Guinness
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: The classic Irish dry stout from St. James's Gate, Dublin, poured as a 20 oz. imperial pint.

🍺 STYLE: Dry stout | 4.1% ABV | Roasted barley, coffee and dark chocolate | Creamy nitrogen head, lighter body than it looks

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Short Rib, Ragu of Italian Meats, burgers and steak, chocolate desserts.

💡 SERVING TIP: Let it settle before topping off; the two-part pour is part of the experience.
location: Guinness, St. James's Gate Brewery, Dublin

name: Copper Legend, Octoberfest
serverNotes:
🍂 📖 ABOUT: Authentic Oktoberfest Märzen from Jack's Abby Craft Lagers in Framingham, MA (founded 2011). Local Massachusetts craft excellence!

🍺 STYLE: Traditional German Märzen | 5.7% ABV, 25 IBU | Rich toasted malt with caramel, bread crust & biscuit notes | Smooth, medium-bodied | Brewed in spring, lagered until fall—honoring Munich tradition.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Bratwurst, pork schnitzel, roasted chicken, pretzels, apple dishes, roasted root vegetables, caramelized onions.

💡 SERVING TIP: Serve cold (45-50°F) in a stein or Märzen glass. This is autumn in a glass!
location: Jack's Abby Craft Lagers, Framingham, MA

name: The Substance Ale
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Bissell Brothers' flagship hoppy ale from Portland, Maine.

🍺 STYLE: Hazy, hop-forward ale | 5.2% ABV | Citrus, pine and tropical fruit over a soft malt base | Smooth, sessionable

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Pizza, Roasted Pork Belly, fried calamari, sandwiches.

💡 SERVING TIP: For IPA fans who want something easier-drinking.
